css: .lx-native-a4{font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;color:#172033;font-size:10.5px}.lx-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:22px;border-bottom:2px solid #172033;padding-bottom:13px;margin-bottom:16px}.lx-brand{max-width:62%}.lx-logo{max-height:46px;max-width:175px;margin-bottom:7px}.lx-brand h1{font-size:22px;margin:0 0 4px}.lx-muted{color:#667085}.lx-title{text-align:right}.lx-title h2{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 5px}.lx-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin:0 0 16px}.lx-box{border:1px solid #d7dee8;border-radius:7px;padding:10px}.lx-box h3{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#667085;margin:0 0 6px}.lx-kv{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:2px 0}.lx-items,.lx-tax{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:12px 0}.lx-items th,.lx-tax th{background:#f2f4f7;padding:6px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid #cfd7e3}.lx-items td,.lx-tax td{padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid #eaecf0;vertical-align:top}.lx-tax{font-size:9px}.lx-num{text-align:right!important}.lx-code{font-size:8.5px;color:#667085;margin-top:2px}.lx-summary{width:44%;margin-left:auto}.lx-summary .lx-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:3px 0}.lx-summary .lx-total{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;border-top:2px solid #172033;margin-top:4px;padding-top:7px}.lx-fbr{margin-top:15px;padding:9px;border:1px solid #cfe8e5;background:#f1faf8;border-radius:7px}.lx-fbr-content{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px}.lx-fbr-logo{max-width:58mm;max-height:18mm;margin-bottom:6px}.lx-qr{width:25.4mm;height:25.4mm;flex:0 0 auto}.lx-banner{font-weight:800;border:2px solid #172033;padding:6px;margin-bottom:7px;text-align:center}.lx-footer{margin-top:20px;border-top:1px solid #d7dee8;padding-top:8px;color:#667085;font-size:8.5px}@media print{@page{size:A4;margin:12mm}}
